title:
Populates the asset report configuration form fields.

For each form field, if a specific value is empty or not provided,
it is retrieved from {@link ReliabilityReportConfig}; otherwise, the selected
form value is used.

Payload receives the following arguments:
  - formId: The ID of the form whose field values are used
    to populate the asset report configuration.
name: PopulateAssetReportConfigurationFields
